correctness.rationale: Independent Markov-state dynamic program using exact Fractions confirmed the displayed run-count adjacent-bin formula for two persistence ratios and three initial biases at even lengths 4..14. Binomial identities and symmetric three-point convolution imply C1>C2; lattice local central limit theorem forces C2/C1 to 1 and hence threshold 2(1-p). The strict finite boundary and reversal witness follow. The finite program does not certify the asymptotic CLT, which is standard under nonzero aperiodic variance.
